name: Koibito = Love x Sex
source:
Sweet love & sex between lovers!

The protagonist starts going out with a girl in his class, Rikka.
However, she is self-willed, loses her temper easily and acts big.
So their physical relation hardly advances.
The protagonist makes up his mind and invites her to his room...

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE045099.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
恋人之间甜蜜的恋爱与性爱！

主人公开始与班上的女生鴫原六花交往。
可是，六花任性、易怒，还总爱摆出一副盛气凌人的架势。
因此，两人的亲密关系一直迟迟没有进展。
主人公终于下定决心，邀请她来到自己的房间……

[改编自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE045099.html]DLsite英文站[/url]]
